# QuickSTI - Certified Payments

> QuickSTI is a comprehensive payment processing platform enabling secure credit card and tax payments with merchant portal access and teller login capabilities.

Operated by Accelerated Card Company, LLC and partnered with Fifth Third Bank, National Association, QuickSTI provides compliant payment processing solutions based in Cincinnati, OH. The platform serves merchants and financial institutions requiring reliable payment processing infrastructure.

## Key Topics

- Payment Processing
- Credit Card Payments
- Tax Payments
- Merchant Portal
- Teller Login
- Legal Compliance
- ISO Certification
- Certified Payments
- Fifth Third Bank
- Accelerated Card Company
- PCI Compliance
- Transaction Security

## Getting Started

- [Certified Payments](https://quicksti.certifiedpayments.net): Certified Payments platform for credit card and tax payment processing
